CisAssetClass.description: One of the classes of enterprise asset that the CIS Controls sort their Safeguards by. Each Safeguard is about one class.
CisAssetClass.title: CisAssetClass

CisControl.description: One of the CIS Controls: a group of Safeguards on one subject, named by its number, such as Control 4.

cis_control_id.description: The Control's identifier, such as CIS-4.

control_safeguards.description: The Safeguards of the Control. A knowledge bundle relates a Safeguard to its Control with isPartOf instead.

description.description: What the Control or Safeguard means to its user, in words its user has the right to use.

title.description: A name for the Control or Safeguard, in words its user has the right to use.

CisControl.title: CisControl

CisControls.description: One edition of the CIS Controls as a whole: its Controls, each holding its Safeguards.

cis_version.description: The edition, as CIS numbers it, such as 8.1, or the revision the guide's pages carry, such as 8.1.2.

CisControls.title: CisControls

CisImplementationGroup.description: One of the three Implementation Groups, CIS's tiers for deciding which Safeguards an enterprise puts in place first. Each group includes every Safeguard of the groups before it.
CisImplementationGroup.title: CisImplementationGroup

CisSafeguard.description: One Safeguard of a Control: a single action an enterprise takes, named by its Control's number and its own, such as Safeguard 4.1.

cis_safeguard_id.description: The Safeguard's identifier, such as CIS-4.1.

description.description: What the Control or Safeguard means to its user, in words its user has the right to use.

safeguard_asset_class.description: The class of enterprise asset the Safeguard is about.

safeguard_implementation_groups.description: The Implementation Groups that include the Safeguard.

safeguard_security_function.description: The security function the Safeguard serves, one of the six functions of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.

title.description: A name for the Control or Safeguard, in words its user has the right to use.

CisSafeguard.title: CisSafeguard

CisSecurityFunction.description: The security function a Safeguard serves. The values are the six functions of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, to which Version 8.1 aligned the CIS Controls.
CisSecurityFunction.title: CisSecurityFunction
